notes.title: An updated De Mambo build has appeared!
notes.content:
From where you ask? Not sure. It was delivered to us by what seemed like a stork. Once it dropped off this new build into our hands, the stork recited a list. What did the list say you ask? Well, take a look here:

- Multiple controller support major overhaul! Controllers will now automatically order themselves as they are connected for all modes!

- Keyboard and controller configurations also majorly improved!

- Icons and text updates for all controllers!

TDK
